sibling_branch_checked_and_rejected.finding: NOT a descendant of the source-baseline commit; diverges from a common ancestor 6352a4c4 and only adds a GitHub Actions CI-isolation workflow (.github/workflows/validate_v10051840_isolated.yml). It is MISSING the kernel-compat layer, the full-field production entry wiring, the preflight launcher, and the parity test file that the source-baseline commit has. Confirmed via `git diff --stat` between the common ancestor and each tip. The source-baseline commit is the more complete / more physics-correct branch; the validation branch is a CI side-branch, not a more-advanced physics branch.

current_branch_divergence_from_baseline.diff_summary: git diff --stat between the baseline commit and current HEAD touches 27 files, 26514 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-). Of these: 25 files are entirely NEW (docs, new standalone pf_theta0_*.py modules, new scripts, new tests) that do not modify any existing physics file. Exactly ONE existing physics file is modified: arrhenius_fracture/sharp_front.py. One existing shell launcher is modified: run_v10_0_5_18_4_0_peak1000_theta0_pf_full_field_parity.sh.

sharp_front_py_diff_verified_additive_on.method: Direct `git diff` read of every hunk between baseline and current HEAD.
sharp_front_py_diff_verified_additive_on.finding: Every change is a NEW code path gated by `if pf_target_active:` / `if pf_target_trajectory is not None:`, or a new CLI flag appended at the very end of _build_parser() before `return p`. The `else:` branch in every conditional is the ORIGINAL statement, unindented and byte-identical (confirmed by the fix in commit c998041, which specifically avoided re-indenting the original mechanics/KJ block to protect ~15 other modules' AST/text-patch anchors on run_2d's source). No anisotropic elasticity, remeshing, MPZ, persistent-site, shielding, bulk Peierls-Taylor, or cohesive code was touched.
sharp_front_py_diff_verified_additive_on.conclusion: The scalar-diagnostic session's changes to sharp_front.py are dead code when --pf-kj-target-csv is absent (the default for every production entry point). This is proven, not assumed.

current_branch_divergence_from_baseline.conclusion: The current branch has NOT diverged materially from the known-good full-physics baseline. Phase 2 recovery strategy: continue on the current branch; no new recovery branch or cherry-pick is required. The scalar controller code may remain in sharp_front.py inertly (default-off) per the instruction that it may remain as an isolated root-finder regression; it is simply never invoked by any production entry point going forward.

kernel_provenance_status.gate_location: mode_i_first_passage_v10_0_5_18_4_0_theta0_pf_parity.py:REFERENCE_KERNEL_SHA256 (= a85b57ad9eee8331ef34ea222760ce7d4064f48ddef668f1e28a666d14946f3a), enforced in both that module's own main() and (identically) in mode_i_first_passage_v10_0_5_18_4_0_theta0_pf_full_field_parity.py:main() via --signed-kernel-family
kernel_provenance_status.current_status: The live PF kernel-cache path's family.json content changed during unrelated concurrent PF-repo activity (observed 2026-08-03/04); no locally-available file currently hashes to a85b57ad9e.... This blocks invoking mode_i_first_passage_v10_0_5_18_4_0_theta0_pf_full_field_production.py end-to-end for a byte-verified 'exact production replication of the historical PF case' claim.
kernel_provenance_status.implication_for_native_loading: A native-loading run (Phase 6) does not need to satisfy this specific hard-coded historical-parity gate at all, because that gate's entire purpose is asserting numerical identity with one specific historical PF run (fixed nx/ny/dU/dt/tip_h_fine/etc. all forced equal to the PF case's own controls -- see _require_* calls in theta0_pf_parity.py:main). A native run is FEM's own independent prediction under its own loading schedule, so it is not required to go through this specific gated wrapper. It can instead invoke the full physics (anisotropic elasticity/remeshing/persistent-site MPZ/bulk PT/signed shielding) through a lower-level entry point (e.g. mode_i_first_passage_v10_0_5_18_3_9_atomic_path_corridor.py or mode_i_first_passage_v10_0_5_14_1_persistent_site_family.py directly) supplying a documented, currently-available kernel snapshot with its own hash recorded and the provenance caveat stated explicitly -- not claimed as historically verified, and not routed through the hash-gated 'theta0_pf_parity' wrapper's exact-match claim.

Note: this module's 'conservative split transport' governs WITHIN-STEP population exchange/advection along the tip-relative x-coordinate (a fixed MPZ frame); it is NOT itself the mechanism that re-anchors the whole MPZ frame's ORIGIN when the crack tip commits a geometric advance a_new-a_old. That re-anchoring is the checkpoint-triggered `self.mpz_state.advance(da)` call inside persistent_site_moving_tip_v100515.py's _integrate_coupled, which Phase 3 must trace against a_new-a_old specifically, not against this module's own internal transport correctness (which already has its own conservation invariants and tests).
